text.combat.intent.activate.reach: levels a spear and holds two paces
text.combat.intent.activate.ranged: takes aim; a bolt follows one clear turn
text.combat.intent.activate.animal: scrapes the mud before a territorial charge
text.combat.intent.activate.machinery: sweeps marked mill aisles on alternating turns
text.combat.intent.activate.elite: checks its {mode} mechanism; a marked warning precedes each of {charges} charges
text.combat.intent.activate.prey: raises its head and looks for a route away from the disturbance
text.combat.intent.activate.predator: watches for prey and exposed movement
text.combat.intent.activate.duty: weighs the disturbance against its {duty} duty
text.combat.brace.reaction: Prepared {weapon} reaction {outcome} the {threat} as it enters the lane.{protection}{dropped}
text.combat.threat.alarm: The {threat} raises an alarm; nearby allies converge on a shared position.
text.combat.threat.net_hit: The {threat} hauls the net across the marked place; footing worsens.
text.combat.threat.net_miss: The {threat}'s net closes on empty ground after your reposition.
text.combat.threat.smoke: The {threat} feeds smoke into a short lane from its station; wind, height, or the control can answer it.
text.combat.threat.retreat_blocked: The {threat} cannot find a safe retreat.
text.combat.threat.escape: The {threat} escapes the encounter with stolen cargo.{loss}
text.combat.threat.escape_lost: The {item} is now recorded as lost beyond the regional route.
text.combat.threat.escape_memory: {threat} escaped {region} with {item}; the physical item was lost.
text.combat.threat.cargo: The {threat} carries stolen cargo toward its escape route.
text.combat.threat.steal: The {threat} takes {item} and turns for an escape route.
text.combat.threat.investigate_empty: The {threat} reaches the sound's origin and finds it empty.
text.combat.threat.investigate_blocked: The {threat} pauses where the investigation route is blocked.
text.combat.threat.investigate: The {threat} investigates without knowing your current position.
text.combat.threat.route_blocked: The {threat} holds; its selected route is blocked.
text.combat.threat.wait: The {threat} holds its duty; it does not know where you are.
text.combat.threat.cross_level: The {threat} hears you on another level.
text.combat.threat.firing_blocked: The {threat} cannot find a firing line.
text.combat.threat.firing_line: The {threat} shifts for a firing line.
text.combat.threat.shot_empty: The {threat} releases along {x},{y}; your movement leaves the lane empty.
text.combat.threat.shot_guard: Guard and {cover} cover turn the {weapon} shot.
text.combat.threat.animal_mud: The {threat} charges into deep mud: a positional evasion.
text.combat.threat.animal_guard: Your guarded footing turns the {threat}'s charge.
text.combat.threat.animal_warning: The {threat} lowers its head: mud, light, or distance can redirect it.
text.combat.threat.no_route: The {threat} holds; no route currently reaches you.
text.combat.attack.no_target: No visible hostile is within this weapon's reach.
text.combat.attack.throwing_axe: The throwing axe must be physically readied.
text.combat.attack.flail_prepare: You wind the flail in an exposed stance; moving abandons this preparation.
text.combat.attack.crossbow_unloaded: The crossbow is unloaded; reload with G.
text.combat.attack.arbalest_reload: The arbalest needs {remaining} more guarded reload action(s).
text.combat.attack.handgonne_load: The handgonne needs {remaining} more guarded loading action(s).
text.combat.attack.no_ammunition: No {ammunition} remain in the physical load.
text.combat.attack.path_blocked: Structure fully blocks that projectile path.
text.combat.attack.prepare: You prepare {weapon} on the {threat}; range {range}, {cover} cover. Firing commits the next action.
text.combat.attack.weather_spoiled: Wet weather spoils the committed string before release.
text.combat.attack.defeated: The strike removes the {threat} from the route: {weapon}.{armour}{recovered}
text.combat.guard.no_danger: There is no expedition danger to guard against.
text.combat.guard.crossbow_reload: You reload the crossbow behind a committed guarded posture.
text.combat.guard.base.shielded: Buckler and set stance deny the attack and press hostile morale.
text.combat.guard.base.strong: You set a reinforced guard; the next reposition preserves control.
text.combat.guard.base.normal: You guard and yield space deliberately.
text.combat.guard.wet.strong: Working grip holds the wet guard.
text.combat.guard.wet.weak: Wet hands weaken the guard; grip coverings or dry ground restore it.
text.combat.guard.counterbrace: The counterbrace pin restores one support and cancels its warned collapse.
text.combat.guard.support: Span-watch stance seats one support and cancels its warning.
text.combat.guard.brace: You visibly brace {weapon} on {threat}; it triggers only if that actor enters or attacks through the valid lane this action.
text.combat.guard.brace_expired: The {threat} does not enter the prepared lane; the brace expires.
